sso_display_name_change_disabled: Display name changes are disabled for SSO accounts.
copy_failed_select_and_copy_manually: Copy failed — select and copy manually
full_control_everything_a_manager_can_do: Full control. Everything a Manager can do, plus granting/revoking Owner and destructive instance operations.
administers_every_team_and_project_invit: Administers every team and project, invites and approves users, sets instance roles (but cannot grant Owner).
no_instance_wide_powers_access_is_limite: No instance-wide powers. Access is limited to the projects of the teams they belong to.
manages_the_team_members_and_their_roles: Manages the team: members and their roles, project settings, and invites for this team.
read_and_triage_the_team_s_projects_view: Read and triage the team’s projects (view issues and events). No team management.
suppress_notifications_for_events_whose_: Suppress notifications for events whose tags match all of the pairs below. Events are still ingested and counted — only alerts are silenced.
no_projects_yet_create_your_first_to_sta: No projects yet — create your first to start capturing errors.
a_project_owns_a_dsn_and_groups_the_erro: A project owns a DSN and groups the errors your SDK sends.
you_need_a_team_before_creating_a_projec: You need a team before creating a project.
name: Name
create_a_project_to_get_a_dsn_and_start_: Create a project to get a DSN and start sending events from your application.
no_projects_match_the_current_filters: No projects match the current filters.
the_display_name_shown_across_the_instan: The display name shown across the instance.
control_whether_new_users_can_register_w: Control whether new users can register without an invite.
when_off_accounts_are_created_only_via_i: When off, accounts are created only via invite.
email_delivery_disabled_by_smtp_enabled: Email delivery is disabled by SMTP_ENABLED=false.
webhooks_disabled_by_webhooks_enabled: Webhook delivery is disabled by WEBHOOKS_ENABLED=false.
email_delivery_is_configured_via_environ: Email delivery is configured via environment variables and shown here read-only.
verify_delivery_end_to_end_leave_the_fie: Verify delivery end-to-end. Leave the field blank to send to your own address.
and_related_variables_to_enable_email_no: and related variables to enable email notifications and invite delivery. Invite links remain copyable without it.
your_display_name_and_account_email: Your display name and account email.
your_email_address_cannot_be_changed: Your email address cannot be changed.
your_language_preference_is_saved_to_you: Your language preference is saved to your account.
email_notifications_for_new_issues_and_r: Email notifications for new issues and regressions.
you_receive_emails_for_new_issues_and_re: You receive emails for new issues and regressions.
sign_in_with_touch_id_windows_hello_or_a: Sign in with Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key instead of your password.
this_browser_cannot_create_passkeys_keys: This browser cannot create passkeys. Keys added elsewhere still work here.
change_the_password_used_to_sign_in: Change the password used to sign in.
enter_your_current_and_new_password: Enter your current and new password
no_unresolved_issues_nice_and_quiet: No unresolved issues — nice and quiet.
setting_a_fingerprint_already_used_by_an: Setting a fingerprint already used by another issue merges them.
no_stacktrace_was_reported_for_this_even: No stacktrace was reported for this event.
no_events_are_available_for_this_issue_o: No events are available for this issue. Older events may have been pruned by retention.
project_name_and_event_retention_by_coun: Project name and event retention (by count and age).
keep_at_most_this_many_recent_events_old: Keep at most this many recent events; older events are pruned. Issue counters are preserved.
0_keep_events_regardless_of_age_otherwis: 0 = keep events regardless of age; otherwise events older than this many days are pruned. Issue counters are preserved.
muting_suppresses_notifications_for_all_: Muting suppresses notifications for all issues in this project. Ingestion and counting continue.
post_new_issue_and_regression_notificati: POST new-issue and regression notifications as JSON to this URL. Leave empty to disable.
suppress_notifications_for_events_whose_: Suppress notifications for events whose tags match a rule. All pairs in a rule must match (AND). Events are still ingested and counted.
move_this_project_to_a_different_team_ac: Move this project to a different team. Access (and admin rights) follow the new team — members of the previous team lose access.
access_to_this_project_comes_from_member: Access to this project comes from membership in its owning team. Add members, set team roles, and create invites from the team page.
deleting_a_project_removes_its_issues_an: Deleting a project removes its issues and events permanently.
project_moved_to_a_different_team: Project moved to a different team
point_your_sentry_compatible_sdk_at_this: Point your Sentry-compatible SDK at this DSN to start sending events to this project.
copy_a_snippet_for_your_language_soika_i: Copy a snippet for your language. soika is a drop-in ingestion endpoint for the Sentry SDK.
trigger_an_error_in_your_application_to_: Trigger an error in your application to send your first event.
new_events_appear_on_the_project_s_issue: New events appear on the project's Issues tab, grouped by fingerprint.
soika_renders_stacktraces_exactly_as_you: soika renders stacktraces exactly as your SDK reports them — no source maps required.
groups_of_users_that_grant_access_to_ass: Groups of users that grant access to assigned projects.
give_the_team_a_name_you_can_add_members: Give the team a name. You can add members afterwards.
who_s_in_this_team_and_what_role_they_ha: Who’s in this team and what role they have.
add_a_teammate_or_share_an_invite_link_t: Add a teammate or share an invite link to give access to this team’s projects.
no_projects_assigned_to_this_team: No projects assigned to this team.
update_the_display_name_for_this_team: Update the display name for this team.
generate_a_link_to_add_someone_to_this_t: Generate a link to add someone to this team. The link works even without email; if SMTP is configured and you provide an address, it is also emailed.
select_a_user_and_a_role_to_add_to_this_: Select a user and a role to add to this team.
this_invite_is_no_longer_valid: This invite is no longer valid.
your_account_is_not_allowed_to_sign_in: Your account is not allowed to sign in.
the_sign_in_request_was_invalid_please_t: The sign-in request was invalid. Please try again.
single_sign_on_failed_please_try_again: Single sign-on failed. Please try again.
you_ve_signed_in_successfully_but_your_a: You've signed in successfully, but your account needs to be approved by an administrator before you can continue.
once_an_administrator_approves_your_acco: Once an administrator approves your account, sign in again to access
public_registration_is_turned_off_for_th: Public registration is turned off for this instance. Ask an administrator for an invite, or sign in if you already have an account.
registration_must_be_enabled_by_an_admin: Registration must be enabled by an administrator.
set_up_your_instance_by_creating_the_adm: Set up your instance by creating the administrator account.
reject_account_confirm: Reject and delete the pending account {email}? This cannot be undone.
delete_account_confirm: Delete the account {email}? This permanently removes the user and cannot be undone.
delete_project_confirm: Delete project “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
awaiting_approval_count: {count, plural, one {# account awaiting approval} other {# accounts awaiting approval}}
projects_filtered: Showing {shown} of {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}.
projects_workspace: {count, plural, one {# project in your workspace.} other {# projects in your workspace.}}
no_project_access: You do not have access to this project
no_issue_access: You do not have access to this issue
no_team_access: You do not have access to this team
unresolved_issue_count: {count, plural, one {# unresolved issue} other {# unresolved issues}}
error_password_short: New password must be at least 8 characters
error_password_unchanged: New password must differ from the current one
error_password_sso: Password login is disabled; use SSO
error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
teams_group_users_and_grant_them_access_: Teams group users and grant them access to the team’s projects.
display_name_minimum: Display name must be at least {count} characters
default_teams_description: New accounts join the selected teams as Contributors, including sign-up, invitations and first SSO sign-in. Existing users and their memberships are unchanged. Leave all teams unchecked to assign none.
default_teams_empty: Create a team first to configure default membership.
team_transfer_required: This team owns {count} projects. Select a team to move them to before deletion.
orphaned_project: Removed from configuration, events are not accepted
orphaned_team: Removed from configuration; membership is frozen
sync_result: Created / updated / unchanged / restored / orphaned / deleted
delete_orphans_warning: Delete policy permanently removes data absent from configuration.
teams_without_sso_warning: OAuth is disabled: new users cannot join.
management_summary_ui_ui: Projects and teams are managed in the UI.
management_summary_yaml_ui: Projects are managed in the configuration file. Teams are managed in the UI.
management_summary_ui_yaml: Teams are managed in the configuration file; sign-up and invites are disabled. Projects are managed in the UI.
management_summary_yaml_yaml: Projects and teams are managed in the configuration file. Mute settings stay in the UI.
auth_config_readonly: Authentication is configured on the server. This page shows the active configuration.
auth_sso_on: Users can sign in through the configured identity provider.
auth_sso_off: No SSO provider is enabled on this instance.
auth_owner_sso: Stored Owners can use SSO only when listed in ADMIN_USERS.
auth_password_all: Password sign-in is available to local accounts.
auth_password_owners: With SSO enabled, password sign-in is limited to local Owners, including accounts listed in ADMIN_USERS.
auth_password_disabled: Password sign-in is disabled for all accounts, including Owners.
auth_passkeys_on: Users can register passkeys in their profile and sign in without a password.
auth_passkeys_off: Passkey registration and sign-in are disabled.
auth_yaml_access: Teams are managed through YAML. Public sign-up and invites are disabled; SSO access follows the configured team grants.
notifications_alertmanager_description: Send issue alerts to Prometheus Alertmanager. Applies to every project.
notifications_lifecycle: New issues and regressions fire an alert. Open alerts refresh every minute; resolving, muting or deleting an issue closes its alert within a minute. Existing issues are not sent when enabling the channel.
notifications_identity: issue_id and project_id labels are added automatically. Labels define alert identity: keep changing values in annotations.
notifications_template_help: Use double braces around a variable name. Values must be strings. Unknown variables are rejected; loops and filters are not supported. Preview uses sample data and sends no alerts.
notifications_string_map: Enter a JSON object whose values are strings.
notifications_webhooks_help: Controlled by WEBHOOKS_ENABLED. Configure each destination in project settings. Webhooks send the Alertmanager webhook format; the Alertmanager channel above sends to its API.
notifications_default_url: Leave the URL empty to use ALERTMANAGER_URL: {url}
notifications_test_help: Uses saved settings and fixed test text in your interface language. Save changes before testing. The alert expires after five minutes.
